faces.name: The Flavormancer
faces.oracleText:
Before the game begins, if The Flavormancer is your commander, legendary creature and planeswalker cards in your deck that are flavorfully Heroes or Villains gain that creature type. (For example, Gideon becomes a Hero and Yawgmoth becomes a Villain. Yes, planeswalkers get creature types this way. Don't worry about it.)
Once during each of your turns, you may cast a Hero or Villain spell from your hand without paying its mana cost.

faces.name: The Flesh Is Weak
faces.oracleText:
When this enchantment enters, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Creatures you control with +1/+1 counters on them are artifacts in addition to their other types.
Nonartifact creatures get -1/-1.

faces.name: The Flood of Mars
faces.oracleText:
Islandwalk (This creature can't be blocked as long as defending player controls an Island.)
Water Always Wins — Whenever this creature attacks, put a flood counter on another target creature or land. If it's a creature, it becomes a copy of this creature. If it's a land, it becomes an Island in addition to its other types.

faces.name: The Flux
faces.oracleText:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after VI.)
I — This Saga deals 4 damage to target creature an opponent controls.
II, III, IV, V — Exile the top card of your library. You may play that card this turn.
VI — Add six {R}.

faces.name: The Food Court
faces.oracleText:
Artifacts are Foods in addition to their other types (They have "{2}, {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: You gain 3 life.")
Sacrifice three Foods: Add {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}. Activate only once each turn and only during your turn.
Chaos: You become the Monarch. If you are already the Monarch, draw a card.

faces.name: The Foretold Soldier
faces.oracleText:
This creature must be blocked if able.
This creature can't be blocked by more than one creature.
Whenever this creature deals damage, exile it face down. It becomes foretold.
Foretell {1}{G} (During your turn, you may pay {2} and exile this card from your hand face down. Cast it on a later turn for its foretell cost.)

faces.name: The Forgotten Place
faces.oracleText:
The Forgotten Place enters the battlefield tapped.
{T}: Add {C}.
{2}, {T}, Sacrifice The Forgotten Place: Draw a card for each Locus and/or Sphere in your graveyard.

faces.name: The Fourteenth Doctor
faces.oracleText:
When you cast this spell, reveal the top fourteen cards of your library. Put all Doctor cards revealed this way into your graveyard and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
You may have The Fourteenth Doctor enter as a copy of a Doctor card in your graveyard that was put there from your library this turn. If you do, it gains haste until end of turn.
